organization.name: European Parliament and Council of the European Union

notes: Co-legislators that adopted the Regulation under the ordinary legislative procedure. Their legislative power traces to the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (Article 114, internal-market harmonisation); that Treaty Instrument is referenced but not minted in this sample, consistent with the recursive authority_basis pattern. This two-authority model (Parliament and Council enact, Commission issues guidelines) is a deliberate teaching construct; EveryAILaw has not minted a separate co-legislator authority, so this record carries no sameAs.
